The final [summary](replay/summary.json) records **66 baseline core net tests passed; 19 applied; each detected only by the added tests; all 47 existing net coretests and 105 doc tests stay green; 0 skipped**. The final replay used [acceptance/intree/replay.py](../../intree/replay.py), including the review edit to inherit `CARGO_HOME` or use `INTREE_CARGO_HOME` for prepared bootstrap dependencies. The script applies exact text replacements, records every result group and restores original source and test bytes. The main patch now contains 12 behavioural tests and the optional patch contains 7 representation snapshots. Both were checked with `git apply --check`, separately and together. No native test was rerun during the publication fixes or patch split.

## Historical receipts

The parent-directory `patch-in-tree.txt`, per-mutant logs, `summary.txt` and `summary.json` were copied from the earlier `intree/logs/b` run. They predate the polished names and strengthened assertions. Their M095 log uses the superseded constant-output mutant; their pending status is historical. M090 was applied by exact text replacement after its patch hunk failed; the historical summary retains both entries. These receipts are retained for provenance and are not the final result.

[copy-manifest.json](copy-manifest.json) binds original and normalized historical receipt bytes. Only paths and the provenance prefix were changed. Original internal receipts remain outside the publication boundary. `rust-tree` denotes the tag checkout. The final replay directory contains the review session's separate receipts.
